keyPoints: Prakriti me sab jeev ek-dusre se jude hain — paudhe, janwar, sukshm jeev, mitti, paani aur hawa milkar paristhitik tantra (ecosystem) banate hain.
Hari paudhe utpadak hain jo bhojan banate hain, janwar upbhokta hain jo use khate hain, aur jivanu-kavak apghatak (decomposer) hain jo mare jeevon ko sadate hain.
Bhojan shringkhala me urja paudhe se shakahari janwar, phir mansahari janwar tak pahunchti hai; kai shringkhalaen milkar bhojan jaal banati hain.
Ek bhi kadi tootne par santulan bigadta hai — mendhak kam honge to keede badhenge aur fasal kha jayenge, jisse kisaano ko nuksan hoga.
Jal-chakra, vayu aur mitti ke poshak chakra prakriti ko chalate hain; andhadhundh ped katne se ye chakra tootne lagte hain.
Jaiv vividhata (biodiversity) prakriti ki taakat hai — jitne zyada prakaar ke jeev honge, tantra utna hi majboot aur sankat se ladne me saksham hoga.
Aam galti: keede-makode aur jivanu bekar samajhna; ye apghatak mare jeevon ko sadakar mitti ko upjaoo banate hain, bina inke jeevan ruk jayega.

title: Prakriti ka Samanjasya
